args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future monster individual PNG artwork.
Primary request: A cute but threatening Seoul gate monster with a single broad kite-shaped body with a folded top crest, rounded lower point and two inward-curling side flaps. Anatomical material: a central soft moth-like capsule surrounded by broad luminous sign-shaped wings, short rounded antennae, big alert eyes and no insect limbs. Face: two deep asymmetrical eye windows above a little smiling seam. Single cohesive body silhouette, no legs, feet, knees, humanoid torso, walking joints or articulated limb rig. Front-three-quarter view, restrained inner magic light, thick readable edge and soft painterly shading. A few small material details must explain its theme rather than recolor another monster. Transparent background, no environment, text, props in hands, or ground pedestal. Designed for one shared flutter motion applied to the entire PNG.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
One cute threatening legless monster. Absolutely NO LEGS, NO FEET, NO WALKING JOINTS, NO HUMAN ARMS. Single cohesive body, full silhouette visible, no floor shadow or ground plane.
Composition: single subject fully inside canvas, centered with 8 percent safe padding. No contact sheet or multiple examples.
Background: actual transparent RGBA, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.
